regulations.name: EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures
key_obligations: Four-fifths rule as screening standard for adverse impact (1607.4(D))
Validity evidence required for procedures that produce adverse impact (1607.14)
Criterion-related validity requires significance at p <= 0.05

regulations.name: NYC Local Law 144 of 2021 (AEDT)
key_obligations: Annual independent bias audit of automated employment decision tools
Public posting of selection rates and impact ratios
Impact ratios required for sex, race/ethnicity, AND intersectional categories
Categories under 2% of data may be excluded from calculations
regulations.penalties: Up to $1,500 per day per violation

regulations.name: Illinois HB 3773 (Human Rights Act amendment)
key_obligations: Prohibits AI that discriminates on protected classes in employment decisions
Notice required when AI is used in hiring, promotion, discharge, or discipline
regulations.note: No impact assessment mandated, unlike the original Colorado approach

regulations.name: Colorado AI Act
regulations.status: SB 24-205 REPEALED before taking effect; replaced by SB 26-189 signed 2026-05-14, effective 2027-01-01
key_obligations: Replacement requires disclosure and human review
Risk-management programmes, annual impact assessments, and duty of care from the original act were removed
regulations.warning: Many published compliance guides still describe the repealed SB 24-205 obligations. Verify before relying on any source describing Colorado requirements.

regulations.name: EU AI Act
regulations.status: Annex III high-risk obligations DEFERRED to 2027-12-02 by the Digital Omnibus (in force 2026-07-27), from the original 2026-08-02
key_obligations: Employment AI classified as high-risk (recruitment, selection, evaluation, promotion, termination)
Risk management, data governance, logging, human oversight, conformity assessment

regulations.name: California FEHA automated-decision-system regulations
key_obligations: Automated-decision-system discrimination rules under state employment law
